tasks.short: Work out costs for warehouse supplies, services and overhead from quotes and agreed rates.

today.trigger: A site requests a cost estimate, a supplier changes rates, or finance needs an updated costing.
steps: Collect supplier quotes, price lists and expected quantities from Outlook and SharePoint.
Check existing supplier charges and cost centres in AFAS Profit.
Calculate costs in Excel, including freight, overhead allocations and recoverable versus non-recoverable VAT.
Resolve unclear rates with the site or supplier and share the calculation.
drudgery: Copying prices from attachments into spreadsheets
Checking quote dates, units and VAT treatment repeatedly
Rebuilding calculations for slightly different quantities
today.time_sinks: Finding the current quote and resolving different units, delivery charges and overhead assumptions.

lenses.faster: Extract quote lines into a standard table and calculate costs using approved formulas. Copying, unit conversion and rebuilding spreadsheets disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A new quote or rate change creates an updated costing automatically. Missing terms and unusual increases enter an exception queue.
lenses.ambitious: Keep costs current for recurring supplies and services across all three sites. Flag price drift before the next purchase.
lenses.joy: Remove attachment handling and repetitive arithmetic. Keep the useful work of explaining cost differences and questioning unexpected charges.
lenses.options: Produce five comparisons using different quantities, suppliers, delivery terms or allocation assumptions. Show which assumptions change the result most.
lenses.altitude: Own the costing rules and quality checks instead of rebuilding each calculation. Track how often quoted costs differ from invoiced costs.
reach: Prepare supplier price comparisons for purchasing

tasks.human_edge: Judge whether quotes cover the same service and whether an allocation reflects how Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo actually operate.
tasks.pattern_why: Use an llm_step to extract unstructured quote terms, followed by deterministic_software for units, arithmetic, VAT treatment and approved allocations. Uncertain extraction must stop automatic use.

in_practice.trigger: An approved quote is added to a designated SharePoint folder or a costing request supplies quantities.
steps: Capture the document version, supplier, validity dates and requested quantities.
Extract prices, units and exclusions with references to the original document.
Validate required fields and run approved cost and VAT formulas.
Compare the result with previous rates and route uncertain terms or large changes for review.
Save the costing and its assumptions for internal use.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper resolves extraction exceptions; the Controller approves new allocation rules. Purchasing decisions and supplier commitments stay with their authorised owners.
systems: Excel or a controlled calculation service
data_needed: Approved overhead allocation and VAT rules
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint costing register containing source versions, extracted values, calculation rules and exception decisions.

evidence.claim: Excel can calculate costs and compare scenarios using structured price and quantity tables.
Document extraction followed by deterministic validation could reduce quote handling at Noordhaven.
A 70% time saving and 3.33 times speedup are untested estimates for this workflow.

risks: Extraction can miss minimum charges, surcharges, expiry dates or decimal commas.
Incorrect unit conversion or VAT treatment can produce a convincing but wrong total.
A calculated saving may compare different service levels or unsuitable suppliers.
research_questions: What proportion of quotes use repeatable formats, and how accurately can critical terms be extracted?
Are overhead allocations and VAT rules documented and approved?
How much of the current 40 hours is calculation versus waiting for commercial clarification?

tasks.short: Match Rabobank transactions to AFAS invoices and explain anything left over.

today.trigger: A bank statement becomes available or the month-close checklist requires bank reconciliation.
steps: Import or obtain Rabobank statement lines and open the corresponding AFAS bank ledger.
Match receipts and payments to open customer and supplier items.
Investigate grouped payments, missing references, bank charges and differences.
Record authorised corrections and reconcile the closing bank balance.
drudgery: Searching invoice numbers and payment references
Matching repeated transactions by hand
Rechecking that every statement line has been accounted for
today.time_sinks: Grouped payments, partial receipts, unidentified payers and timing differences between statements and the ledger.

lenses.faster: Import statements once and apply exact, approved matching rules. The bookkeeper starts with unresolved items and the balance check.
lenses.autonomous: Each imported statement triggers reconciliation and an exception list. Routine matches run without reminders.
lenses.ambitious: Reconcile daily so missing receipts and payment problems surface before close. Give collections a reliable view of genuinely unpaid invoices.
lenses.joy: Remove reference searches and repetitive matching. Keep investigation of unusual receipts and resolving customer payment problems.
lenses.options: For an ambiguous receipt, show ranked invoice combinations with amounts and supporting references. Present suggestions for a person to choose.
lenses.altitude: Manage matching rules, exception ageing and reconciliation quality. Improve the causes of unmatched payments with collections and treasury.
reach: Prepare cash-position checks for the Accountant
Identify disputed or unidentified receipts for the Credit and Collections Officer

tasks.human_edge: Resolve ambiguous ownership of receipts and decide when a discrepancy requires an accounting correction or customer contact.
tasks.pattern_why: Statement import, exact matching, duplicate prevention and balance reconciliation are deterministic_software tasks. Ambiguous matches can receive suggestions, but should not be posted from a model's guess.

in_practice.trigger: A complete Rabobank statement is imported into AFAS through an approved connection or file process.
steps: Check statement identifiers, account, completeness and duplicate imports.
Match using approved references, amounts and customer or supplier identifiers.
Apply approved rules for recurring bank charges and permitted payment differences.
Queue ambiguous, unmatched or out-of-tolerance items with supporting records.
Reconcile statement and ledger balances and record the outcome.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper approves ambiguous allocations. Write-offs and correcting entries follow existing authorisation limits; this workflow has no authority to release payments or change bank details.
systems: Rabobank statement export or approved bank connection
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS transaction history and a restricted reconciliation register recording statement IDs, matching rules, exceptions and approvals.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit supports electronic bank statement processing and reconciliation features.
Noordhaven's available statement formats, licences and matching configuration still need verification.
An 80% time saving and five times speedup depend on a high share of routine matches.

risks: An incorrect match can hide an overdue customer balance or settle the wrong supplier item.
Duplicate imports or incomplete statements can create false reconciliation results.
Unrestricted difference rules can turn exceptions into unauthorised write-offs.
research_questions: What share of statement lines already matches automatically in AFAS?
Which Rabobank import or connection options are available in the current AFAS setup?
How frequent are grouped payments, partial payments and missing references?
Can every automatic match be reversed and traced to its statement line and rule?

tasks.short: Prepare cash, payable, receivable and profit reports that agree with AFAS.

today.trigger: A scheduled finance report, month close or an ad hoc question requires updated figures.
steps: Obtain AFAS balances and transaction extracts or use the nightly Power BI dataset.
Combine and filter cash, AP, AR and profit-and-loss data by period and site.
Build Excel tables and reconcile totals to the ledger.
Explain unusual movements and share the report with the relevant finance owner.
drudgery: Exporting the same reports repeatedly
Copying figures into recurring tables
Repairing filters and checking spreadsheet versions
today.time_sinks: Reconciling inconsistent definitions, investigating stale extracts and answering questions about different report versions.

lenses.faster: Build standard reports from one approved dataset with automatic ledger checks. Repeated exports, formatting and manual total comparisons disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A successful nightly refresh generates the standard reports and flags failed checks. Each report displays its source timestamp.
lenses.ambitious: Provide consistent daily views of overdue balances, cash movements and site costs. Track exceptions that threaten the month-close timetable.
lenses.joy: Remove spreadsheet assembly and version chasing. Keep answering useful questions and explaining movements.
lenses.options: Provide views by site, customer, supplier, ageing band and reporting period from the same figures. Let users investigate without requesting another spreadsheet.
lenses.altitude: Own report definitions, reconciliation controls and data-quality alerts. Measure whether reports help finance resolve issues sooner.
reach: Prepare recurring management-report tables for the Controller
Supply reconciled cash and working-capital data to FP&A

tasks.human_edge: Explain whether a movement is an operational change, a timing issue or an accounting error, and challenge misleading comparisons.
tasks.pattern_why: Data selection, grouping, accounting totals and scheduled distribution fit deterministic_software. Any generated explanation is an optional llm_step grounded in the checked figures and reviewed before use.

in_practice.trigger: The nightly AFAS extract refresh completes successfully or an authorised user requests a defined report.
steps: Check source freshness, extract completeness and the reporting period.
Apply approved account, site and ageing definitions.
Reconcile report totals to the corresponding AFAS control totals.
Generate standard tables and a list of unusual movements.
Publish passed reports to the restricted finance workspace and route failures for review.
in_practice.human_gate: The Controller approves definitions and changes to published reports. The bookkeeper reviews failed checks and any narrative commentary; final close figures require the existing close approval.
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted reporting register in SharePoint with dataset timestamps, definition versions, reconciliation results and publication history.

evidence.claim: Power BI supports scheduled refresh and reusable reports; Noordhaven already uses a nightly AFAS extract.
evidence.source: Microsoft Power BI; company systems supplied in the brief

evidence.claim: Standardised definitions and ledger control totals can make recurring financial reports reproducible.
A 75% time saving and four times speedup are untested estimates for report preparation.

risks: A report can reconcile overall while using incorrect site mappings or ageing definitions.
The nightly extract cannot support claims about live cash or same-day postings.
Broad report access can expose supplier banking information or employee-related transactions.
Generated commentary can invent causes that the financial data does not establish.
research_questions: Which recurring reports still require manual work outside the existing Power BI dashboards?
Can each report reconcile to a defined AFAS total for the same timestamp?
Which account and site mappings cause repeated corrections?
Does the nightly refresh meet the actual reporting deadlines?

tasks.short: Prepare the trial balance and flag ledger problems before month close.

today.trigger: A close checkpoint, accountant request or audit request needs a trial balance.
steps: Select the entity, period and posting status in AFAS Profit.
Produce the trial balance and export a working copy when needed.
Check debit and credit totals, opening balances and AP and AR control accounts.
Investigate discrepancies and hand the checked balance to the Accountant.
drudgery: Repeating report selections and exports
Comparing control balances manually
Rebuilding the same close checklist
today.time_sinks: Investigating suspense balances, incomplete postings and differences between subledgers and the general ledger.

lenses.faster: Generate the trial balance with a fixed set of control checks. Manual preparation and repeated comparisons disappear.
lenses.autonomous: Each close checkpoint produces a dated trial balance and exception list. Failed controls are assigned to an owner.
lenses.ambitious: Run close checks during the month so errors reach finance before the deadline. Track recurring issues by account and site.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated exports and tick-box checks. Keep investigating the accounting problems that matter.
lenses.options: Show the balance before and after proposed adjustments, with a separate view of unresolved items. Keep proposed entries outside the posted ledger.
lenses.altitude: Own the trial-balance control framework and improve first-pass close quality. Focus on why exceptions recur.
reach: Maintain reconciliation evidence for the Accountant
Coordinate the ledger-readiness checklist for the Controller

tasks.human_edge: Recognise that balanced debits and credits do not prove correct accounting, and identify when an apparent reconciliation conceals a substantive error.
tasks.pattern_why: AFAS already calculates the trial balance. The improvement is deterministic_software that runs repeatable completeness and reconciliation checks, leaving accounting judgement and adjustments with authorised people.

in_practice.trigger: A scheduled close checkpoint runs against an identified AFAS ledger snapshot.
steps: Capture entity, period, posting status and source timestamp.
Generate the trial balance and verify debit and credit totals and opening-balance continuity.
Compare AP, AR and bank control balances with corresponding reconciliations.
Flag suspense accounts, unusual movements and incomplete reconciliation evidence.
Save the working balance and assign exceptions before the close deadline.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper resolves preparation exceptions. The Accountant approves adjusting journals and the Controller approves final close readiness.
data_needed: AP, AR and bank reconciliation totals
in_practice.logs_to: The restricted SharePoint close file, retaining source timestamps, control results, exception ownership and approval records.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit provides financial ledger reporting, including trial balances.
Repeatable checks can automate preparation controls but cannot prove that all underlying accounting is correct.
An 80% time saving and five times speedup assume most effort is repeatable preparation and checking.

risks: A balanced trial balance can still contain omitted, duplicated or misclassified transactions.
Reports from different timestamps can create false subledger differences.
Incorrect thresholds may suppress important exceptions.
Late postings can invalidate a previously checked snapshot.
research_questions: How much of the 32.4 hours is report generation versus substantive investigation?
Can all control comparisons use the same period and posting cutoff?
Which historical close errors would the proposed checks have detected?
Who owns exceptions and approves changes after a snapshot is checked?

tasks.short: Gather budget inputs and assemble a checked pack for FP&A.

today.trigger: FP&A opens a budget round or requests inputs for a forecast update.
steps: Collect prior budgets, AFAS actuals and current supplier commitments.
Request revenue and expense assumptions from site and budget owners.
Combine inputs in Excel and map them to accounts, sites and periods.
Check missing inputs and unusual changes, then send the pack to FP&A.
drudgery: Copying figures between budget files
Chasing missing inputs and inconsistent versions
Repairing account mappings and spreadsheet formulas
today.time_sinks: Waiting for site assumptions, reconciling different templates and finding which version a budget owner approved.

lenses.faster: Load actuals, commitments and approved inputs into one controlled template. Repeated copying, mapping and formula repair disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A budget round creates input requests, loads available figures and tracks missing submissions. It produces a review pack when required inputs arrive.
lenses.ambitious: Refresh the supporting budget data monthly and retain every assumption's owner and date. Give FP&A earlier warning of changes in agency rates and site costs.
lenses.joy: Remove spreadsheet stitching and version chasing. Keep questioning unexplained changes and helping sites provide usable inputs.
lenses.options: Prepare base, peak-season, lower-volume, higher-agency-rate and delayed-customer-payment scenarios using approved drivers. Show the effect on costs and cash.
lenses.altitude: Own the completeness and traceability of budget inputs. Improve the process that supplies a forecast the business trusts.
reach: Prepare cost and working-capital schedules for FP&A
Coordinate budget-input deadlines with site managers

tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a credible operating assumption from a convenient spreadsheet number and obtain accountable confirmation from budget owners.
tasks.pattern_why: An agent_with_gate can collect inputs, check versions, track gaps and assemble the pack. Deterministic formulas calculate scenarios; budget owners and FP&A retain responsibility for assumptions and the forecast.

in_practice.trigger: FP&A starts an approved budget or forecast round with defined owners, templates and deadlines.
steps: Load actuals, previous budgets and authorised commitment data into a standard schema.
Collect site inputs through a controlled template and track outstanding fields.
Validate account mappings, periods, formulas and assumption ownership.
Calculate approved scenarios and highlight changes needing explanation.
Present the versioned pack for bookkeeper review and FP&A acceptance.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper approves each compiled pack. Site owners confirm their assumptions; Payroll validates applicable CAO and employer-cost inputs, and FP&A approves the forecast.
systems: Teams or Outlook through an approved internal reminder workflow
data_needed: Input owners, deadlines and version status
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint budget register with input versions, owners, validation results, scenario assumptions and approvals.

evidence.claim: Excel Power Query can combine repeatable data sources and refresh a budget-input table.
A gated workflow could track missing inputs and assemble a traceable pack across Noordhaven's sites.
A 65% time saving and 2.86 times speedup are untested and depend on timely input from budget owners.

risks: Scenario calculations can appear authoritative despite weak volume or staffing assumptions.
Agency labour costs may include rate changes, overtime and surcharges absent from a simple hourly-rate table.
The two CAO arrangements require validated assumptions rather than model interpretation.
Employee-level pay or flex-worker details can be exposed unnecessarily; use approved aggregates for compilation.
research_questions: What share of inputs arrives in a consistent template with an identifiable owner?
Can commitments and agency rates be exported reliably from the available systems?
Which labour-cost assumptions must Payroll validate under each applicable CAO?
Does compilation effort or waiting for budget owners dominate the current task?

tasks.short: Keep finance's stock records current and investigate differences reported by the sites.

today.trigger: A site supplies receipts, issues, count results or month-end stock information.
steps: Obtain stock movements and count records from Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo.
Update finance's quantity and value records.
Compare movements with purchases, usage and relevant AFAS balances.
Investigate differences with site staff and obtain approval for adjustments.
systems: Excel stock records, assumed pending discovery
Site stock records; operational inventory system not specified
drudgery: Rekeying stock movements
Matching different item descriptions
Comparing count sheets with financial records
today.time_sinks: Late site records, inconsistent units and uncertainty about whether stock belongs to Noordhaven or a customer.

lenses.faster: Import structured movement and count records and calculate differences automatically. Rekeying and repeated spreadsheet comparisons disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A validated movement batch creates proposed finance-record updates and a discrepancy list. Automatic posting should wait until source reliability is demonstrated.
lenses.ambitious: Track recurring losses, obsolete supplies and unexplained adjustments by site. Improve financial stock accuracy between physical counts.
lenses.joy: Remove transcription and item-code searches. Keep working with sites to understand discrepancies and prevent repeat losses.
lenses.options: Show alternative treatments for a discrepancy, such as a missing receipt, wrong unit or proposed write-off. Quantify each without changing the ledger.
lenses.altitude: Own financial stock reconciliation rules and source-quality checks. Help sites prevent errors at the point movements are recorded.
reach: Prepare stock valuation reconciliation for the Accountant
Analyse recurring stock discrepancies with warehouse operations

tasks.human_edge: Establish physical reality, ownership and responsibility with warehouse staff; a data match alone cannot confirm that stock exists.
tasks.pattern_why: Use agent_with_gate for source collection, discrepancy investigation support and proposed updates, with deterministic_software for quantities and valuation rules. The unspecified operational inventory system prevents a credible claim of fully autonomous maintenance.

in_practice.trigger: A site submits an approved stock-movement batch or physical-count file.
steps: Check batch identity, site, ownership, item codes, units and cutoff dates.
Reconcile opening quantities plus movements to the reported closing quantities.
Calculate values using the Accountant's approved valuation method.
Flag negative stock, missing movements, count differences and ownership uncertainty.
Present proposed record updates and adjustments for approval, then retain reconciliation evidence.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper approves each finance-record update batch after site confirmation. The Accountant approves valuation changes and journals; authorised managers approve write-offs.
systems: Validated site stock exports or controlled Excel templates
Excel or a controlled reconciliation service
data_needed: Agreed scope of Noordhaven-owned versus customer-owned stock
Site confirmation and financial cutoff dates
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint stock reconciliation register linked to source batches, count evidence, approvals and any AFAS journals.

evidence.claim: Excel Power Query can consolidate structured stock files and support repeatable reconciliation calculations.
Reliable movement records and clear ownership are prerequisites for automated financial stock maintenance.
The proposed source integration, 60% time saving and 2.5 times speedup are untested because the operational inventory system is unspecified.

risks: Customer goods held in Noordhaven's warehouses could be incorrectly treated as company inventory.
Missing movements or inconsistent units can create false stock balances.
Automated records cannot replace physical counts or establish responsibility for losses.
Wrong cutoff or valuation rules can distort month-end costs and assets.
research_questions: Does this task cover company supplies, goods owned by Noordhaven, customer stock records, or several distinct scopes?
Which system is the authoritative source for stock movements and physical counts?
Are item codes, units, ownership and valuation methods consistent across the three sites?
How often do financial differences require a physical investigation rather than a data correction?

tasks.short: Prepare Dutch tax and contribution paperwork and route it to the authorised filer.

today.trigger: A tax or contribution deadline arrives, or the Accountant or Payroll Specialist requests supporting documents.
steps: Identify the Dutch obligation, reporting period and responsible filing owner.
Collect relevant AFAS figures, supporting invoices and prior submissions.
Populate the required schedules and reconcile them to finance or payroll records.
Obtain authorised review, submit within delegated rights if applicable, and retain the receipt.
systems: AFAS Profit finance and authorised payroll reports
Applicable Belastingdienst, pension fund or UWV filing channel
drudgery: Copying reconciled totals into recurring schedules
Finding supporting documents and prior receipts
Checking required fields and deadlines repeatedly
today.time_sinks: Resolving tax-code exceptions, establishing which owner must file, and obtaining confirmed payroll or pension figures.

lenses.faster: Populate recurring schedules from reconciled AFAS records and run completeness checks. Repeated copying and document gathering disappear.
lenses.autonomous: The filing calendar creates a draft pack and flags missing evidence before each deadline. Submission runs only after explicit approval through an authorised channel.
lenses.ambitious: Keep an obligation register with owners, deadlines, reconciliation status and receipts. Catch missing evidence well before filing day.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive form filling and receipt chasing. Keep resolving unusual transactions with the Accountant or Payroll Specialist.
lenses.options: Show alternative treatments for uncertain items with the figures affected and the question requiring expert judgement. Apply only the approved treatment.
lenses.altitude: Own the completeness and audit trail of filing preparation. Improve the process so the responsible specialist receives a checked pack.
reach: Prepare VAT reconciliation schedules for the Accountant
Assemble approved contribution evidence for the Payroll Specialist

tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a transaction needs Dutch tax or pension expertise and ensure an accountable, authorised person accepts the filing.
tasks.pattern_why: An agent_with_gate can assemble evidence and prepare drafts, while deterministic_software calculates approved fields and reconciliations. Legal interpretations and each external submission require the responsible human's approval.

in_practice.trigger: An approved obligation register reaches its preparation date for a specific period and filing owner.
steps: Select the current official form or supported software filing schema.
Load reconciled finance data and only the payroll totals authorised for this obligation.
Calculate draft fields using approved rules and check totals, periods and required evidence.
Route uncertain treatments and the completed pack to the Accountant or Payroll Specialist.
After explicit approval, submit through the authorised channel and retain acceptance or rejection evidence.
in_practice.human_gate: The Accountant approves tax treatments and tax filings; Payroll approves payroll and pension figures. The bookkeeper submits only where formally delegated, and every submission requires approval.
systems: Official or approved tax and contribution filing channels
data_needed: Actual Dutch obligations and delegated filing rights
Reconciled VAT and relevant ledger balances
Approved aggregate payroll or pension figures where required
Supporting documents and prior filing receipts
Applicable CAO and pension arrangements confirmed by Payroll
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint filing register containing source periods, calculation versions, reviewer approval, submission identifiers and acceptance receipts.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit supports Dutch VAT declaration preparation.
The US-style workers' compensation wording needs mapping to Noordhaven's actual Dutch tax, pension and any UWV obligations rather than direct translation.
A 50% time saving and two times speedup are untested estimates including specialist review.

risks: Using outdated forms or incorrect tax rules can cause rejected or inaccurate filings.
A submission receipt may confirm delivery without confirming acceptance.
Payroll and pension obligations could be duplicated or assigned to the wrong finance employee.
Employee details require restricted access under AVG/GDPR; medical and Wet verbetering poortwachter case records should stay outside this bookkeeping workflow.
research_questions: Which Dutch filings does the bookkeeper actually prepare or submit, and which belong entirely to Payroll or the Accountant?
Which current filing channels and AFAS features are licensed and supported?
Can each proposed field reconcile to an approved source and current official definition?
How much effort remains for specialist judgement and approval after preparation is automated?

role.altitude: Become the owner of reliable transaction records and reconciliation controls: maintain rules, resolve exceptions and deliver checked inputs for close, collections and forecasting.
reach: Prepare cash and working-capital schedules for FP&A
Maintain reconciliation evidence and filing packs for the Accountant
Coordinate ledger-readiness checks for the Controller
Investigate unidentified receipts with the Credit and Collections Officer
Analyse supplier-rate and stock discrepancies with purchasing and site operations
role.ceiling_note: The current workflows are illustrative, not observed company procedures. These seven tasks cover 215.6 hours per FTE annually, about 13.5% of a 1,600-hour year. The estimates imply about 152.2 hours released per FTE, or 457 hours across three FTE, worth about EUR 20,550 annually at EUR 45/hour as capacity rather than guaranteed cash savings. Savings and speedups are pilot hypotheses for task execution including review; source delays and approval queues can reduce elapsed-time gains. Do not extrapolate them to the rest of AP and AR or count the same released hours twice. Physical stock checks, tax judgement, payment authority and forecast ownership remain with their designated owners. The proposed finance automation does not itself imply an EU AI Act high-risk employment use; extending it into employee evaluation requires a separate assessment and consideration of applicable OR rights.
skills_to_grow: Configure and test AFAS matching, imports and financial reports
Build controlled Excel Power Query and Power BI workflows
Define reconciliation controls and investigate exceptions
Validate document extraction against source evidence
Maintain source versions, approvals and reproducible audit trails
Understand Dutch VAT basics and route CAO, payroll and pension questions to the responsible specialist
Measure touchless processing, exception ageing, close delays and correction rates
role.ambitious_version: Run a daily finance control process across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo that catches unresolved bank items, stale supplier rates, stock differences and missing forecast inputs before month close. Use released time to fix recurring causes with sites and finance owners, helping the team close sooner with fewer audit adjustments and a forecast grounded in checked transactions.
